objective: Improve robustness beyond v8 toward real leaderboard 0.63–0.65; no calibrated leaderboard forecast is available
resources: CPU only, one numerical thread, nice 15, CUDA hidden; no shared queue or training-file changes

hypotheses.arithmetic: Frozen deployment decoder provides an honest baseline against which to measure inference changes
hypotheses.geometric: Agreement across members suppresses isolated false event peaks, but may suppress correct minority evidence
hypotheses.median: Pointwise median probabilities resist unusually confident members, but may lose useful diversity

protocol: All recipes have nine members per fold. Require every seed/fold. Report original349 and common duplicate-excluded subset. Attributes remain arithmetic averaged. No parameter fitting. Leave-one-seed-out stability uses all three predeclared two-seed subsets.
promotion_gate: Screen only: clean pooled delta >=0.005; no major source loss >0.01; gain in >=2/3 seed subsets. Before adoption require matched rate/crop stress, source holdout and runtime parity. No arithmetic conversion from CV gain to expected LB.
limitations: Existing folds contain cross-fold duplicates; exclusion is diagnostic, not a substitute for grouped retraining. Checkpoints were selected on validation. Multiple candidate screening remains optimistic. No GPU work until existing jobs permit it.
